claim.title: GD with small init recovers low-rank PSD matrix in over-parameterized matrix sensing
claim.statement: Under (4r,δ)-RIP, gradient descent on f(U)=1/(2m)Σ(y_i-<A_i,UU^T>)^2 with U∈R^{d×d}, initialization U0=αB (B orthonormal) and small step size achieves ||U_T U_T^T - X*||_F^2 ≲ α√d/κ^2 for every T in the range (κ log(d/α))/η ≲ T ≲ 1/(η√d κ α).
claim.test_plan: Simulate with d=100, r=5, U* Gaussian with columns normalized, X*=U*U*^T, and m=5dr symmetric Gaussian A_i. Run GD with η=0.0025 and α∈{1e-1,1e-2,1e-3,1e-4}, using U0=αI. For each α, record ||UU^T-X*||_F^2 after convergence (around 1e4 iterations), averaged over 3 seeds. Then regress log(error) on log(α).
claim.evidence_in_paper: Theorem 1.1 and Theorem 4.1 (proof); Figures 1-3 give empirical support.
claim.success_criterion: Final squared recovery error decreases as α decreases, consistent with O(α√d) scaling: the fitted log-log slope is positive (about 1), and error is small (≪1) for small α while the training loss is near zero.
claim.success_criterion_source: derived from the claim's error bound ∝ α√d/κ^2
